integrity: Exact-analytic proof and reproducible exact rational/symbolic checks; no independent audit. All files in this package contain neutral mathematical discussion and reproducibility materials.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite connected noncomplete unweighted undirected strongly regular graph Laplacians and completed sixth-order Gauss steps in exact arithmetic only. No guarantee for internal RK stages, nonlinear problems, weighted/directed graphs, or floating-point errors; specialized unindexed literature is a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp positivity frontier for sixth-order Gauss diffusion on strongly regular graphs
